data.title: 鸣濑白羽 · 木造旧校舍走廊的抱膝听雨
data.description: 古旧木造海岛小学的空旷走廊深处，窗外大雨淅淅沥沥。白羽双手抱膝坐在木地板窗台下，下巴搁在膝盖上，静静看着窗外雨水顺着屋檐滴落。
data.location: rustic wooden hallway of an abandoned island elementary school on a rainy afternoon
data.action: sitting on polished wooden floor hugging knees against chest, chin resting on knees, listening to rain with quiet thoughtful purple eyes
data.lighting: 雨天窗棂透入的清幽漫射冷光
data.promptProse: Shiroha sits on the wooden floor of an old island school hugging her knees, peacefully listening to raindrops fall past the window.
data.animaCaption: Soft grey rainlight through the tall glass window outlines her quiet pose on the wooden floor.
